# Proposal: Pebble Pantry MVP

Prepared for: Pebble Pantry Ltd (fictional startup), founders Lena Brandt (CEO) and Kofi Mensah (CTO).

## The product
A meal-planning app for small households. Users plan a week of meals, the app builds a shopping list
and suggests recipes from what is already in the pantry.

## Scope of this engagement (8 weeks)
- Mobile app (React Native) for iOS and Android: onboarding, weekly planner, shopping list.
- Backend API (Node + Postgres) with auth, recipes, pantry items.
- Recipe import from a partner feed (JSON over HTTPS).
- Out of scope: payments, social features, web app.

## Milestones
- M1 2026-10-09: clickable planner + API skeleton
- M2 2026-10-30: shopping list and pantry sync
- M3 2026-11-20: store-ready beta (TestFlight + Play internal testing)

## Team
Me (contractor): full-stack lead. Kofi reviews code. A freelance designer, Sara Lind, delivers Figma screens.

## Rate
Weekly retainer, invoiced every other Friday.
